ArgonTest.Name: Enum variant method override
ArgonTest.InputSource:
module _ import Argon.Core::*
enum Greeting public virtual def self.message(): String = "default"
Default
Custom with public override def self.message(): String = "custom" end
record Named value: String public override def self.message(): String = "record variant" end end
proc main(): () do let default = Greeting.Default let custom = Greeting.Custom let named = Greeting.Named { value: "ignored" } puts (default.message ()) puts (custom.message ()) puts (named.message ()) end
